summary: Civista Bancshares filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing only the timing of its third-quarter 2026 earnings release. The $4.3 billion Ohio-based financial holding company said results will be issued before market open on October 22, 2026, with a conference call and webcast at 1:00 p.m. Eastern that day. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle or deal term applies.
